subject: Media Literacy
title: The Future of Advertising
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Future of Advertising.

hook.text: AI can now generate personalized ads in real-time, tailored to your mood detected from your phone's sensors.

buildup.text: Advertising is evolving toward hyper-personalization — ads that adapt to your emotions and context in real time.

discovery.text: AR ads will overlay products into your real world. VR ads will place you inside immersive brand experiences.

twist.text: As ads become indistinguishable from content and reality, media literacy becomes a survival skill.

climax.text: The advertising of the future won't feel like advertising. That's exactly what makes it dangerous.

punchline.text: The best ad is the one you never realize you saw.

quiz.question: Why is the future of advertising potentially more dangerous?
options: Ads are becoming indistinguishable from content and reality
People are becoming better at spotting ads
